protocol.split: First eight bytes of SHA256(UTF8('OPH-deep-held-v1') + NUL + UTF8(galaxy)), big-endian, modulo five. Each galaxy is held once.
protocol.weighting: Equal galaxy weights in training and scoring; equal weights per retained radius within a galaxy.
protocol.selection: Quality <=2, inclination >=30 deg, positive speeds and baryon acceleration, gbar < 1.2e-11 m/s^2; primary relative velocity error <=0.10. Disk/bulge M/L 0.5/0.7.
protocol.interval: 4000 paired galaxy bootstrap draws, seed 20261122, conditional on the five training fits. Excludes refitting and shared catalogue systematics.
protocol.shared_inputs: Observed and baryon accelerations use the same radius; the galaxy distance, orientation and baryonic mass model are catalogue inputs.
protocol.source_identification: SPARC records rotation speeds and baryonic components. No independent measurement of the modular collar charge or conversion from that charge to acceleration is present.
protocol.scope: Retrospective within-catalogue prediction. The empirical RAR was originally inferred using SPARC; holding out galaxies here tests transfer of fitted scale, not discovery on new observations.

shared_ring_inputs.control: Multiply only outer Vobs by 1.2 after selection, holding baryons, radii and membership fixed.
shared_ring_inputs.scope: Single-ring ratio only. The published channel A fit also uses interior deep radii.

compact_exterior_profile.selection: Bulge absent at every catalogue ring, quality <= 2, inclination >= 30 deg, measured positive disk scale length and HI isodensity radius, R >= max(4 Rdisk, RHI), nominal 0 < gbar < 1.2e-11 m/s^2. Includes every qualifying speed regardless of error or excess sign.
compact_exterior_profile.model: V^2 = Vgas|Vgas| + Upsilon Vdisk|Vdisk| + sqrt(G Mphot a0), in consistent units. Mphot = Upsilon L_3.6 + 1.33 M_HI. Angular geometry and photometric flux held fixed as D varies. One common a0. RHI is the 1 solar mass/pc^2 crossing. An exterior compact source and settled spherical cuts are additional hypotheses.
compact_exterior_profile.geometry_boxes: Widths multiply quoted distance and inclination errors. Width 0 uses Upsilon=0.5. Nonzero widths use [0.4,0.6]. Necessary intervals release shared parameters by ring. Witness uses one distance, inclination and mass-to-light ratio per galaxy.
compact_exterior_profile.simultaneous_velocity_threshold: Bonferroni two-sided 95% threshold conditional on marginal Gaussian catalogue speed errors, selection and nuisance boxes. Includes no joint probability model for geometry, baryonic systematics or noncircular motions.

nonnegative_nondecreasing_enclosed_mass_.method: At nominal geometry permit any nonnegative nondecreasing spherical mass per galaxy. At each ordered radius R, intersect the interval R[(V +/- k e)^2 - Vbar^2] with all preceding lower bounds and zero. Truncate the lower velocity endpoint at zero. Duplicate radii must share a mass. Fold fixed bulge M/L 0.7 into Vbar for the extended sample.

amplitude_transfer_from_disjoint_galaxie.training: Same primary deep radial cut and equal-galaxy log-acceleration loss as the five-fold analysis. Exclude every exterior test galaxy. Transfer its single fitted a0 from gobs = gbar + sqrt(gbar a0) to the compact photometric exterior profile.
amplitude_transfer_from_disjoint_galaxie.training_galaxy_bootstrap: 2000 galaxy-cluster resamples with replacement, refitting each calibration, seed 20261123. Conditions on the catalogue inputs.

paired_baryon_source_transfer.comparison: Fixed training scale and identical exterior selection. Compact extra squared speed sqrt(G Mphot a0); local-force extra sqrt(R Vbar² a0) in consistent units. Both add to the same Vbar². The force-equivalent mass R Vbar²/G does not measure the physical mass enclosed by a disk or a modular charge.
paired_baryon_source_transfer.bounds: Necessary per-ring residuals in catalogue speed units. The wide case allows every nuisance and every calibration inside the training bootstrap interval independently at each ring. Error fractions condition on the catalogue model. Shared galaxy constraints can only increase the required errors.

nominal_predictions_kms.row_order: Use the galaxy list consecutively, taking the listed number of radius and speed entries for each galaxy.

limiting_ring_primary_source_check.source: Chemin et al. (2006), section 5.1 and table 7, https://arxiv.org/abs/astro-ph/0609148
limiting_ring_primary_source_check.model: Projection sensitivity on the limiting ring only. Hold the tabulated angular baryonic-force profile fixed; maximize over its catalogue distance box and disk M/L. Use the published morphologies as independent angle estimates on the same target. A new joint velocity-field and baryonic-image reduction would have to redetermine the radii and deprojected material distributions.

external_geometry_sensitivity.distance_source: Schombert, McGaugh & Lelli (2020), Table 2, TRGB entries; section 2.3 attributes distances and errors to Tully et al. (2019). https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-3881/ab9d88
external_geometry_sensitivity.inclination_source: Dicaire et al. (2008), Table 4 and Appendix A, inner H-alpha tilted-ring inclinations. https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1365-2966.2008.12868.x
external_geometry_sensitivity.application: Retain the original outer sample, force profiles and angular bins. Replace a geometry input for every available match within the stated table and method. Otherwise retain the catalogue input. Use twice the tabulated distance/inclination errors and disk M/L between 0.4 and 0.6. These conditional projection tests use a disjoint fixed scale. Stellar distances are independent of the ring velocities; independent imaging between the distance compilations is unverified. The angle of an inner H-alpha field may differ from that of its outer H I disk. Surface-density profiles would have to be redetermined in a complete image and velocity-field reduction.
